why: The MOL test launch photo (Figure 55 of the Dorian compendium), a striped Titan IIIC with the Gemini B capsule on top rising on a white plume against a dark sky, is one centred vertical object with the strongest light and dark shapes in the topic, while the KH-8 N1 frame is soft with a label arrow through its middle and the Horizon drawings are small grainy page scans.
